build_sync_mime_server: build a SyncMimeServer instance with a global IFLModel and optional channel for MIME federated learning
create_mime_server_config: create a SyncMimeServerConfig dataclass to configure MIME server aggregation type and optimizer settings
broadcast_mime_message_to_clients: broadcast a Message with control variate and optimizer state to clients using broadcast_message_to_clients
run_mime_server_step: run the MIME server step to update optimizer state and aggregate model parameters via SGD
set_mime_server_defaults: set default active user selector and server optimizer in the MIME server config via _set_defaults_in_cfg
